# Calleo

> Calleo is a language-learning app for creating custom vocabulary word sets and practicing them through interactive games. It supports 40+ languages, generates word pairs with AI, and syncs progress across iOS and web.

Calleo is completely free: no ads, no subscriptions and no in-app purchases. It is available as a native iOS app and a web app; with an account, sets and progress sync across both.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://calleo.xyz/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Web App](https://app.calleo.xyz/): use Calleo directly in the browser, no install required
- [iOS App](https://apps.apple.com/ua/app/calleo-learn-words-with-ai/id6759112720): native app on the App Store

## Key features

- AI-powered word generation: instantly generate vocabulary word pairs and translations for any topic
- Quick Generate: turn a single topic (e.g. "restaurant," "travel") into a ready-to-use vocabulary set instantly, with AI skipping words you already have
- Wordwall Import: import existing word sets directly from Wordwall
- 6 interactive learning modes: Flashcards, Match Game, Quiz Mode, Fill in the Blank, Listening, Writing
- Learn (CEFR Path): a guided, auto-progressing curriculum spanning all six CEFR levels (A1 through C2), unlocking the next focused set as you pass each quiz
- Word Tinder: swipe-based quick review of known/unknown words
- Custom word sets: create, edit, and organize vocabulary lists manually or via AI
- Sharing: turn any set into a share code; anyone with the code can preview the set and copy it into their own collection, and the owner sees view and copy counts (there is no public discovery feed)
- 40+ languages supported, with full interface localization
- Cross-platform sync between iOS and web (guest mode available, no account required to start)
- Privacy: guest mode needs no account and keeps sets on the device; with an account, Calleo stores your email and the sets you create. Words and topics sent to the AI go to OpenAI for translations, transcriptions and examples; email and account data do not

## Pricing

Calleo is free. There are no ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases and no paid tier. Unlimited word sets, all 6 game modes, AI generation, sharing and cross-platform sync are available to everyone.

## Support & policies

- [Support / Help Center](https://calleo.xyz/support): getting started, account management, creating sets, game modes, sharing, settings, troubleshooting
- [Privacy Policy](https://calleo.xyz/privacy-policy): what data is collected, third-party sharing, data deletion

## Localization

The marketing site is available in 14 languages (English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Ukrainian, Russian, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Portuguese, Turkish, Indonesian) at `/`, `/de`, `/es`, `/fr`, `/it`, `/pl`, `/uk`, `/ru`, `/zh`, `/ko`, `/ar`, `/pt`, `/tr`, `/id` respectively (English has no path prefix).
